status: planned — NOT built; standalone reproduction of the upstream sample/350BT subset, built ONLY from its own source objects (never a key-order prefix of the per-crawl corpus)
revision_note: immutable source revision is pinned by the lock phase at build time
tokenizer_rev_note: immutable tokenizer revision, asset digest, and implementation version are pinned by the lock phase
hash_seed_note: per-corpus seed derived by the lock phase from the recipe and locked source state
exclude_note: ONLY the standalone sample/350BT objects (the real upstream path) are selected — source membership is the reproduction's identity
upstream_filtering: preserved — the published FineWeb-Edu educational-score filtering is taken as-is

dedup_policy.cross_crawl: retain cross-crawl duplicates — NO global dedup
dedup_policy.dev_repetition_filter: NOT applied (the legacy dev-only repetition filter is dropped)

transforms_note: upstream-only: no pithos transforms — no global dedup, no legacy repetition filter

validation_reservation.method: domain-separated keyed hash of the document key

ordering: global ascending keyed BLAKE2b-128 over (crawl, document_id); the key order IS the uniform global shuffle
encoding: [BOS] + tokens + [EOS] per document; documents whose tokenization contains the EOS id are dropped (counted, bounded by max_eos_drop_rate)
publish_root_note: immutable publish destination is pinned by the lock phase at build time

full.description: the standalone sample/350BT reproduction train stream

validation.description: the reserved 0.1% validation split of the sample/350BT reproduction

identity: no identity until built: a built corpus is identified by its manifest.json canonical sha256, verified at read time
